user.title: Add Aqara device
user.description: Pick a discovered Aqara device, or enter the device's LAN IP and DID manually if nothing was found on the network. The DID looks like `lumi1.0123456789ab` (the suffix is the device's MAC address) and is shown in the Aqara app under device settings.

credentials.title: Aqara cloud credentials
credentials.description: Enter your Aqara account email, password, and region. If you already have an Aqara user ID and token (for example from another tool), you can paste them in the optional fields instead and skip the cloud login.

confirm.title: Confirm device setup

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Aqara device
reauth_confirm.description: The Aqara cloud token for {account} was rejected. Enter the account password to refresh the token, or paste a new Aqara user ID and token directly. The device connection details are unchanged.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Aqara device
reconfigure.description: Update the Aqara cloud credentials for {account}. Enter the account password to refresh the token, or paste a new Aqara user ID and token directly. The device connection details (IP, DID, model) are unchanged.

error.aqara_login_failed: Aqara cloud login failed. Check your email, password, and region.
error.aqara_credentials_required: Enter either your Aqara account email and password, or paste a user ID and token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not validate against the hub. Check that the hub is on the same network as Home Assistant and that the credentials are correct.
error.not_tunnel_host: This device is reachable but is not a LANLink tunnel host (for example an M100 hub). Its devices can be added under a compatible hub such as the M3.
error.not_lanlink: This device responded but is not a LANLink device.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname (no spaces or special characters).

abort.already_configured: This Aqara device is already configured.

init.title: Camera configuration
init.description: IP address and RTSP credentials for this hub's built-in camera. Leave the IP blank to let the integration auto-discover it.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname (no spaces or special characters).

abort.not_a_camera: This hub has no built-in camera, so there is nothing to configure.

pick_device.title: Add an Aqara device
pick_device.description:
Pick a device to add to Home Assistant ({supported_count} eligible). Add one device per run; rerun this flow to add more. {unsupported_info}

Contributions for unsupported devices are welcome.

device_extras.title: Device configuration
device_extras.description: Provide any extra configuration this device needs before it can be added.

bootstrap_review.title: Review traits for new device ({model})
bootstrap_review.description: This device (`{did}`) is not yet in the shipped catalogue. Pick which discovered traits to enable as entities. Skipped traits can be added later via the `scan_device` service.

manual_activate.title: Activate a device by IP
manual_activate.description: Auto-discovery did not find this device on your network. Pick it from your Aqara account and enter its LAN IP address so the hub can be told to relay it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Aqara cloud to list devices on this hub. Check your network and try again.
error.extras_validation_failed: The device configuration could not be validated. Check the values and try again.
error.invalid_ip: That is not a valid IP address.
error.no_manual_devices: No devices available for manual activation.
error.unknown_device: The selected device is no longer in the cloud's device list. Reopen the picker and try again.

abort.unknown_device: The selected device is no longer in the cloud's device list. Reopen the picker and try again.
abort.bootstrap_cloud_failed: Could not scan the new device's traits because the Aqara cloud is unreachable. Add the device now (it will have no entities yet) and re-run `aqara_lanlink.scan_device` once the cloud is available.

play_audio_file.name: Play audio file
play_audio_file.description: Stream an AAC-ADTS audio file through an Aqara doorbell's voice channel.

device_id.name: Doorbell
device_id.description: The Aqara doorbell to play the audio through.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Absolute path to an AAC-ADTS audio file. The directory must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

scan_device.name: Scan device for new traits
scan_device.description: Runs a one-shot cloud scan against one Aqara device to recover traits the shipped catalogue is missing. Intended for the small number of models not yet catalogued, or when firmware adds new traits to a previously catalogued model; not needed for routine use.

export_overlay.name: Export overlay for PR
export_overlay.description: Renders accepted overlay traits as a Python TraitSpec snippet ready to paste into a model package's overrides.py OVERRIDES dict, then posts the result as a Persistent Notification. Intended for submitting catalogue PRs after running scan_device.

model.name: Model
model.description: Restrict the export to one model. Omit to render all models in the overlay.

ptz.name: PTZ control
ptz.description: Control a PTZ camera with a single action. The command selects what to do; value, continuous, and duration refine it. One service so dashboards (including the WebRTC card) can drive every PTZ action through one action key.

command.name: Command
command.description: What to do. up/down/left/right pan or tilt; stop halts a continuous move; zoom_in/zoom_out step the zoom; zoom sets an absolute magnification (needs value); preset recalls a saved position (needs value).

value.name: Value
value.description: For zoom: the magnification (1.0 widest to 9.0 tele). For zoom_in/zoom_out: the step size in magnification (default 1.0). For preset: the preset name (as set in the Aqara app) or its numeric id. Ignored by other commands.

continuous.name: Continuous
continuous.description: For up/down/left/right, move continuously until stop is sent (or duration elapses) instead of a single nudge.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: For a continuous directional move, seconds to move before auto-stopping. Omit to move until stop.

push_stalled.title: Aqara hub stopped sending updates
push_stalled.description: The hub is connected but has stopped forwarding device updates over the local tunnel, and repeated automatic recovery attempts have not helped. First check that "LAN Control" is enabled for this hub in the Aqara app. The hub keeps its push-relay table in persistent storage that survives reboots, so if rebooting the hub does not restore updates, a factory reset of the hub is the only reliable fix (re-pair the hub and its devices afterwards).

confirm.title: Run scan_device to review
confirm.description: Dismiss this notification and invoke `aqara_lanlink.scan_device(device_id=...)` for each device listed.

select.title: Review discovered traits ({count})
select.description:
The cloud scan of `{did}` found {count} traits the catalogue does not cover yet. Pick which to add as entities on this device. The accepted entries also become a ready-to-submit PR payload via the `export_overlay` service.

{details}

scan_failure.title: Cloud scan failed for {did}
scan_failure.description: The integration could not complete the scan: {message}. Re-run `aqara_lanlink.scan_device` when the cloud is reachable.
